summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #39. Committed: (1) permanent solver parity corpus harness + seed corpus (10 cases incl. ties, exclusions, weight flips, unmatched), (2) OpenAPI adoption probe tests (red: spec/manifest absent by design pending implementation run and viamin/color_matching#110), (3) PaletteAPIClient /api/v1 wire-contract safety-net tests for the generated-client migration. swift test could NOT be executed: this Linux container has no Swift toolchain and ColorComposerCore targets macOS 13 (Xcode 16 host required). Seed-corpus expectations were cross-validated by simulating the documented WeightedSquaredErrorScorer semantics in Python (10/10 cases: selections, scores within 1e-9, tie equality within 1e-12, unmatched). bin/lint passes (diff/conflict-marker checks; Swift build skipped gracefully without a toolchain).
environment_blockers: No Swift toolchain in this container (`swift` not found) — swift test / bin/lint's build+test stage cannot execute; ColorComposerCore builds only on macOS 13+ / Xcode 16.

Upstream dependencies not yet published: OpenAPI spec (viamin/color_matching#110) and parity corpus generator (viamin/color_matching#111) are unmerged, so the OpenAPI document and the Elixir-generated corpus are not vendorable yet; a hand-derived seed corpus stands in.
